title: ursinia tenuifolia subsp. ciliaris
intro: Ursinia tenuifolia subsp. ciliaris, commonly known as False Cape Weed, is a plant species native to South Africa. It has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues. The health benefits of Ursinia tenuifolia subsp. ciliaris include its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can aid in wound healing and reduce the risk of infections. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including sesquiterpene lactones and phenolic compounds, which have been shown to exhibit antioxidant and anti-inflammatory effects.
